title: A release's Play upload can be cancelled while it waits
what: The release's upload to Play and the store-listing run share one waiting line that keeps only one waiting run. If a listing or upload run is going and two more are started, the one that waited first is cancelled, which can be the release's own upload to the testing tracks.
expected: Every waiting Play run waits its turn; none is dropped.
how_often: rare: only when three Play runs overlap
fix_line: Retry a cancelled release upload, or give the release upload its own waiting line

title: The Razorpay check passes on main when its keys are gone
what: On a push to main the Razorpay test check runs with the stored test keys. If those keys are removed or empty, it prints SKIPPED and passes green, so a missing key looks like a working payment check.
expected: On main or a hand start, missing keys turn the check red; only a fork or pull request may skip.
who: the owner relying on the payment check
how_often: every push to main while the keys are missing
fix_line: Fail the check on main when the keys are missing
